scope: Exact compatible toolchain reference gate: verified installed native Linux and Windows/private WSL installations, actual Ruby rule controls, four analog process variants with DRC/LVS faults/repairs, three digital profiles with native antenna/power faults, and required hosted implementation execution. This does not qualify complete PDK device coverage, final streamed GDS or tapeout.
installation_history: The same archive first passed clean Linux/Windows installation on backend 0f4ab60; after the diode-model correction, full installed-file integrity and every acceptance case were rerun on backend 35f429b. The source backend is separately captured, and the native archive is unchanged.

steps.name: Require actual KLayout Ruby rules and deliberate geometry failure
Require real mapped timing, equivalence, fault detection and RTL to GDS
Require SKY130, GF180 and IHP counter implementation and extracted timing
Require UART and APB FIFO proof and physical closure on all three profiles
Require final antenna and power-grid checks with actual layout faults
Require independent SKY130 library and interconnect corner coverage

final_gds_diagnostic.scope: Exploratory captured-deck checks; not foundry qualification. SKY130 deck defaults disable FEOL.

limitations: All results have their exact source, engine and process revision scope; later source/runtime changes require appropriate requalification.
The SKY130 analog coupon uses physical adapter 9a491f0ebd51a0aa, not a claim that the smaller bundled simulation manifest includes its physical decks.
GF180-D has analog engine controls but still has no digital profile.
IHP full-deck diagnostic still has 12 density/fill markers. SKY130 diagnostic still omits FEOL. GF180 production geometry/fill remains unresolved.
Core inverter controls do not qualify all devices, analog performance, independent RC conditions, I/O/reliability, full chips or foundry acceptance.
Fresh source-driven runtime installs do not qualify exact final frozen desktop packages.

hosted_failure.scope: SKY130 HD and GF180-C APB finish rejected valid protection diodes as missing gate models. The hosted toolchain gate is still incomplete.

antenna_model_regression.semantics: Logic inputs require positive gate area. Declared CORE ANTENNACELL inputs require positive diffusion area. Ordinary diffusion-only cells remain rejected. No geometry or rule changes to the original checkpoints.
limitations: Native original-checkpoint regression only; fresh complete hosted implementation remains pending.
Updated backend requires current-source installed-runtime qualification; earlier acceptance records do not qualify it.
Final GDS physical closure, complete PDK coverage and tapeout remain unqualified.
